title: Hiring artists for comic and animation teams
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! I’m excited to see y’all’s portfolios! I’m so excited to have the team grow! I’m like a little studio now! ⭐️Stay stellar!! Application Links are in my linktree (in bio)

author: harrier_studio

author: attenboroughac
title: Paid mural painter needed for exhibition
content: Open Call: Painting a mural for an exhibition at Attenborough Arts Centre. Jemisha Maadhavji is looking for artist/s to paint a floral wallpaper mural on one 10m wall. Open to all including students and recent graduates. Comfortable using acrylic paints. Commission fee £750. Materials provided. Duration 3 days: 28-30 September 2026. Location Attenborough Arts Centre, Leicester. Send short bio, why suitable, portfolio to jemishamaadhavji7@gmail.com and Cc mybc1@leicester.ac.uk by 21st September 2026.

author: wscf.europe
title: Call for illustrator for MOZAIK 44
content: CALL FOR ILLUSTRATOR — MOZAIK 44. We’re looking for an illustrator to bring the next edition of MOZAIK to life through visual storytelling. Send us: CV, motivation letter & portfolio. Deadline: 30 September 2026. Email: wscf@wscf-europe.org
